comparison.objective: Send a loaded tote down a roller conveyor to a far station without a hard impact; candidate screens media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Impart and regulate tote motion remotely while preserving load stability versus close bimanual pouring, tilting, and agitation of a separating screen.
comparison.success_condition: Tote must stop at the station with upright contained bottle, impact ≤0.40 m/s, no lifting/tipping, robot outside a keep-out zone, and 1 s stillness. Candidate requires complete pouring, ≥98% media recovery, total washer retention, no spill/contamination/damage, and released screen support. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Conveyor transport with momentum and stopping control is not orientation-selective screening.
